name: QSC_ELIGIBILITY_RULES_
description: This table stores details of the eligibility rules for Sales Catalog.

columns.name: ELIGIBILITY_RULE_ID
columns.description: Eligibility Rule Identifier

columns.name: REVISION_NUM
columns.description: Revision Number

columns.name: RULE_OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Parent type for this rule

columns.name: PROD_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Product Group Identifier. Foreign Key to QSC_PROD_GROUPS_B.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Inventory Item Identifier. References an item.

columns.name: INV_ORG_ID
columns.description: Inventory Organization Identifier for the item.

columns.name: RULE_TYPE
columns.description: Rule Type

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_TYPE
columns.description: Type of geography.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a geography.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the eligibility rule is active.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date after which the eligibility rule is not active.

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Persistent Id used to reference the original version.

columns.name: CHANGE_NUM
columns.description: Column for internal use. Used internally for publishing product groups.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_CODE
columns.description: Geography Code

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
